<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_properties"><sys_properties action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choices/><description/><ignore_cache>false</ignore_cache><is_private>false</is_private><name>ailg.task.update.nap</name><read_roles>now_assist_panel_user</read_roles><suffix/><sys_class_name>sys_properties</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>rakesh.rathod</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-29 04:00:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>aa218fc3280987507f44a59764a09ef8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>85</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ailg.task.update.nap</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_properties_aa218fc3280987507f44a59764a09ef8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 07:36:36</sys_updated_on><type>string</type><value><style>details[open] .arrow-icon { transform: rotate(180deg); }summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }</style><span style="display:none">Task Details Message</span>
<strong>Module 7: Apply business rules and migrate customizations: Task 7 of 8</strong><br />
Lab 7.2.3 - Complete the Update Set

<div style="
    background: #F7F7F7;
    padding: 1px 12px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-top: 16px;
">
    <div style="display: inline-flex;
height: 30px;
padding: 8px;
align-items: center;
gap:8px;
border-radius: 4px;
background:#BCCAD4;
margin:10px 0;
">
<img src="x_1234_sn_ailg.scenario.svg"/>
<h3 style="color: #1D1D1D;
font-family: 'ServiceNow Sans';
font-size: 14px;
font-style: normal;
font-weight: 450;
line-height: 14px;
text-transform: uppercase;">SCENARIO</h3></div><br />You are a ServiceNow administrator who has successfully captured form layout changes for the Service Catalog in your Sim Update Set. After verifying that all required configuration changes have been tracked, you are now ready to prepare the Update Set for migration to the testing environment. The next step in your change management process is to mark the Update Set as complete and export it as an XML file so it can be retrieved and applied by other ServiceNow instances.</p>
<p><div style="display: inline-flex;
height: 30px;
padding: 8px;
align-items: center;
gap:8px;
border-radius: 4px;
background:#9FE793;
margin:10px 0;
box-sizing: border-box;
">
<img src="x_1234_sn_ailg.clipboard-list.svg"/>
<h3 style="color: #1D1D1D;
font-family: 'ServiceNow Sans';
font-size: 14px;
font-style: normal;
font-weight: 450;
line-height: 14px; 
text-transform: uppercase;">TASK OBJECTIVE</h3>
</div><br />In this simulator task, you will finalize and export your Update Set for migration.</p>
<p>1. Change the Sim Update Set State from In progress to Complete.</p>
<p>2. Update the record, then export the record via &#39;Export to XML&#39; in Related Links or use the context menu (three dots) &gt; Export &gt; XML (This Record). </p>
<p>3. Verify the update set has been downloaded to your local computer.</p>
<p>To begin, select the globe icon at the top of your instance. Hover over &#39;Sim Update Set [Global]&#39; and select the Open record icon. </p>
<p> </p>

    <!-- Key Concepts Accordion -->
    <div style="
        margin-top: 16px;
        border-top: 1px solid #DADDE2;
        padding-top: 12px;
    ">
<details style="margin-top: 16px;">
    <summary style="
        cursor: pointer;
        list-style: none;
        outline: none;
    ">

        <span class="arrow-icon" style="float:right; transition: transform 0.2s ease;">
            <img src="x_1234_sn_ailg.arrow.png" width="12" height="12"/>
        </span>
        Show key concepts
    </summary> 

    <div style="margin-top: 12px;">
        <p><strong>Lesson</strong><br />Marking an Update Set as Complete is a critical step in the change management lifecycle that signals the configuration changes are ready for migration. When you change the state to Complete, the Update Set becomes available for other instances to retrieve while preventing any additional customizations from being tracked in that set. Exporting the completed Update Set as an XML file creates a portable package that can be transferred between instances through the retrieve and commit process.</p>
    </div>
</details>

    </div>
</div>
